terminal_slice_v6.ready.notes: verify_slices.py on these rows: ceilings hold; it flags 20 rows > 32K (max 50,057, medium/hard, within the plan's band caps) and episode mean windows, which PLAN_v6 drops. Handoff: handoff_v6_terminal.md.

swe_trim.rule: Dean's v6r2 targeted trim: per band the same fraction; unverified-submit episodes first, then the end of the band's draw order with the language shares protected (orchestrator, 2026-10-13 ~13:45 ET)

normalisation: The trainer's loss is token-weighted: the sum of token losses divided by the trained (assistant-mask) tokens of the accumulation window, so a slice's gradient share equals its loss-token share; sequence-token shares set the training time. Both are recorded.
